epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease full stack local startup time from >15 minutes to <2 minutes
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at repository root to start the full stack
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for system verification

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml and health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing local containerization for this epic, I want to create a docker-compose file and configure health checks, so that the stack can be launched and verified
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an empty local environment,
When a developer runs docker-compose up,
Then the full stack starts successfully and the health-check endpoint returns 200 OK.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease time to verify full stack locally from >15 minutes to <2 minutes

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time required to update or delete materials from >10 minutes to <1 minute
epics.tocConstraintRef: Inability to manage existing materials via UI
requirements: R1: Add UI controls to update existing epidemiological materials
R2: Add UI controls to delete existing epidemiological materials

slices.title: Implement UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the update and delete UI for this epic, I want to wire frontend buttons to existing PUT and DELETE endpoints, so that materials can be managed directly from the UI
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog,
When a user clicks edit or delete and confirms,
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding API endpoint and the catalog UI is updated.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase UI-driven successful material updates from 0 to >95%

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0 per month
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated access to the catalog and material creation
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in

slices.title: Implement authentication guards for catalog access
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to add session guards to existing endpoints and routes, so that unauthenticated access is blocked
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user,
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material,
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase authentication check coverage on sensitive endpoints from 0% to 100%
